violated_contract: When stripping live/test Stripe key prefixes from error text, each replacement must advance the search cursor past the replacement. Substituting rk_live_[redacted] (or the sk_/pk_ equivalents) and searching from index 0 rematches the marker forever, so a 403 that echoes a truncated or asterisk-masked key hangs instead of printing the permission failure.
canonical_prevention: redact() finds each marker from an advancing start index (past marker + [redacted]), consumes asterisk-masked tails, and caps replacements so a regress cannot hang. Census and dump GET paths parse Stripe error JSON before redacting.
